name: tortoiseshell
_about: A tortoiseshell -- the small tortoiseshell (Aglais urticae), 5 cm across the wings: bright orange-red, the costa barred black and yellow, a white spot near the tip, the hindwing's base dark and hairy, a row of blue lunules in the dark border of both wings; beneath two-toned bark. A brush-foot (four walking legs). Basking, wings spread. Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
